scope: One existing AAT/donor-lung-preservation program only: human function/provenance, formulation/exposure, product/capture and marginal-dollar integration. Broader new-opportunity screening excluded.

selection.objective: Expected discounted financial value retained by ddiscov after remaining development, commercial and rights costs, sharing and financing.

selection.basis: User-selected bounded existing-program review after six closed source passes. Inherited conditional rank7; no broader new-opportunity screening or fresh full-portfolio valuation.

delta.finding: Exact recovered rank7 cost row prices initial formulation/potency/process qualification only at US$30–100k/two-to-four months; scarce organs and transplant validation are excluded.
delta.impact: Preserve qualification as the original priced action. Do not transfer the P2 human-function budget or impose a completed graft result before informative feasibility.

delta.finding: A primary2019 author thesis provides eight-pair methods, replenished nominal exposure and incomplete repeated observations;2020/2026 lineage likely overlaps. Full2026 methods remain unverified; patent five-donor provenance is not additive.
delta.impact: Narrow feasibility uncertainty without creating independent replication, complete12h denominators or proven transplantability.

delta.finding: 2018 cold recombinant-AAT preservation includes a storage-solution rinse with retained graft AAT at4h. Published2023 pig systemic-recipient treatment improves early oxygen recovery;2025 AATD augmentation remains observational with distinct enrollment/comparison sets.
delta.impact: Retain early functional support without relabeling it as warm-EVLP-only durable recipient benefit or survival superiority.

delta.finding: Nominal added AAT, human-antigen ELISA and functional inhibitory activity differ; pig3mg/mL versus0.5mg/mL antigen remains unexplained. Perfusate replacement, protein/excipients/electrolytes and IV handling limits constrain interpretation.
delta.impact: An activity/process qualification is informative. Do not invent a loss fraction, inactive fraction, warm stability specification or clinical safety margin.

delta.topic: Product, granted claims and clinical stage
delta.finding: AU/KR grant existence was already recorded; this review inspects original granted versions and limitations. US status remains unresolved, Canadian UHN trial remains displayed notyetrecruiting, and approved-IV biological product/platform labeling do not establish an EVLP product route.
delta.impact: Price a specific retained contribution rather than assume generic availability, licensed rights, FTO, clinical results or an automatic regulatory pathway.

delta.finding: Useful finite-processing protection may involve retained tissue AAT or physical formulation. Dualprotease mechanistic uniqueness, complete drug-free tissue and permanent repair are not universal requirements for a valuable graft outcome.
delta.impact: Compare actual clinically useful and practical advantage plus remaining costs and retained economics. Mechanistic claims and stronger repair/durability claims require their own evidence.
